# Data Masking regex composition reference

Generated by tools/reference/generate-regex.mjs against the installed @aws-lambda-powertools/data-masking v2.35.0 package. Thirty cases compare complete resulting values and shared RegExp.lastIndex after top-level traversal or ordered selected-field rules. The original JSON object order is retained through json.RawMessage. The corpus includes null, numeric and boolean leaves, strategy precedence, global/sticky flags and named captures.

This fixture tests actual DataMasking.erase calls. The larger low-level String.prototype.replace corpus belongs to commons/regex. No AWS provider or cryptographic behavior is represented.
